_note: Each flight = one clip + the model that runs on it (+ telemetry). api_key_env names an .env variable holding the API key for that model's workspace; omitted = ROBOFLOW_API_KEY. alert_classes = class names that count as 'line down' (default: any class containing 'broken'). show_classes = classes visible by default (all are still tracked; toggle in the UI). cache = pre-computed detections (scripts/precompute.py) so the demo plays instantly with no live inference dependency. annotated = the clip already has the model's render burned in, so play it untouched and draw nothing over it.
